title: Cataloguing a large disc collection
scenario: Marcus has a few hundred discs and wants them in a searchable list by Sunday night.
goal: Catalogue everything with the least typing

stages.name: Decide to start
actions: Searches for a way to list his discs
thoughts: Typing every title would take forever

pain_points.text: Pricing and export terms unclear before install

opportunities: State pricing and export plainly on the first screen

stages.name: Add the first 20 discs
thoughts: Why does it close after every code?
opportunities: Keep the scanner open and queue results for review

stages.name: Fix the misses

pain_points.text: No quick manual entry for unmatched codes

opportunities: Offer manual entry with the scanned code prefilled

stages.name: Trust and keep it
actions: Checks it opens in a spreadsheet
thoughts: I need to own my data
opportunities: Make export one tap and show what is included

moments_of_truth: Stage 3: after the first few discs he decides whether the tool will finish the job
not_validated: Everything: this sample is illustrative and uses no real research
next_research: Five task sessions with people who own 200+ discs
